tools.name: submit_scan
tools.description: Submit a URL to be graded for AI-agent discoverability. Returns a scan id to poll.

url.description: Public URL of the site to scan.

tools.name: get_grade
tools.description: Get the latest completed grade for a previously-scanned host.

tools.name: colony_agent_login
tools.description: Sign in with a Colony agent identity for an authenticated-tier AgentDisco API key: pre-exchange your Colony credential at the Colony (OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange, RFC 8693, audience colony_gNvs-06hD2sPmBWHgQ4skwGUMpDwqmcl) and pass the resulting id_token — only a token minted for AgentDisco is accepted, never a raw Colony credential. Non-interactive and agent-only; the returned ak_ key authenticates subsequent calls as Authorization: Bearer.

id_token.description: An id_token pre-exchanged at the Colony with AgentDisco as the audience.

note: These tools are currently exposed over plain HTTP at https://agentdisco.io/api/v1 — see https://agentdisco.io/api/docs for the OpenAPI UI. A native JSON-RPC MCP endpoint is on the roadmap; this descriptor advertises the capability set so MCP-aware agents can bridge to the HTTP surface.
